title: sqlv_render_logs
description: Parse MyBatis, p6spy, Hibernate or JdbcTemplate log text into statements, duplicates and N+1 groups.

text.description: Log text supplied by the caller. Nothing is read from the IDE console.

options.description: Parser knobs; every field is optional.

slow_threshold_ms.description: Statements with duration at or above this go into slow.

n_plus_one_threshold.description: Minimum repeat count for an N+1 group (at least 2).

ignore_params_in_dedupe.description: Group duplicates by the literal-parameterised template instead of exact SQL.

dedupe_window_ms.description: Duplicate window in milliseconds; null means the whole text.

timestamp_offset_minutes.description: Minutes east of UTC for timestamps without an explicit zone.

recognize_bare_sql.description: Recognise Hibernate bare SQL rows without the Hibernate: prefix.
